definitions.explanation: An organized event where members of a group (workplace, school, neighborhood, etc.) socialize to strengthen personal relationships. More structured than a casual party.

examples.japanese: {親睦会|しんぼくかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}した→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
⟦{新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歓迎|かんげい}→歓迎：02557_kangei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{兼|か}ねた→兼ねる：11668_kaneru⟧{親睦会|しんぼくかい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A social gathering was held that also served as a welcome event for new employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町内会|ちょうないかい}→町内会：10193_chounaikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧、{親睦会|しんぼくかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}して→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧{住民同士|じゅうみんどうし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{深|ふか}めている→深める：02407_fukameru⟧。
examples.english: The neighborhood association holds social gatherings twice a year to deepen interaction among residents.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{親睦|しんぼく}→親睦：09128_shinboku⟧ (friendship, fellowship) and ⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧ (meeting, gathering).

Common in Japanese workplace and community culture. These events often involve eating and drinking together. In a company context, they may be semi-mandatory — attending shows team spirit.
